name: Cybo

sources.title: Claim help (search-indexed) — free account required; claim via check-mark icon on the listing page or the Edit Business flow; duplicates already claimed need a support ticket
Country directory page (search-indexed) — confirms public 'Add a Business' route at cybo.com/add-business
Batch-provided submission URL — returned HTTP 403 (Zendesk bot-blocked)

conditions: Adding/claiming a business is free ('There is no charge') but requires a registered account
It is a local-business yellow-pages directory — the listing needs a real business with an address/phone; a purely online SaaS without a local presence is a marginal fit
Many businesses are already listed from data feeds — claim the existing listing instead of creating a duplicate
requirements: Real business details: name, address, phone, category, website
If a listing already exists and is unclaimed, claim it via the listing page check-mark icon or the Edit Business button; if it was claimed by another account, contact support@cybo.com
preparation: Search cybo.com for the business first (data-feed listings are common)
Consistent NAP: business name, address, phone
workflow: Register a free account at cybo.com/register
Search for the business; if found unclaimed, use the check-mark 'claim' icon or 'Edit Business' on the listing page
If not found, use cybo.com/add-business to create the listing
Accept the Terms & Conditions step to submit
Verify the public listing page is live with the correct details
watchFor: cybo.com and its Zendesk support site 403 automated fetches — use a browser
Duplicate/feed-sourced listings are common — check carefully before adding a new one
US/local-business orientation; global online-only products may look out of place
Claimed-by-another-account conflicts require a manual support ticket
countsAsLive: The business listing page on cybo.com is publicly viewable and shows as claimed/associated with the account, with correct NAP and website link
unknowns: Whether listing website links are dofollow
Review/verification step for new business adds
Whether online-only businesses are accepted or removed
